description: Source code for the DiskBlockManager class in Apache Spark, responsible for managing disk storage of data blocks, including directory creation, file handling, and cleanup.

classes.name: DiskBlockManager
classes.description: Manages disk storage for blocks, including directory setup, file retrieval, and cleanup.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns a File object for a given filename, hashed into local directories.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns a File object for a given BlockId.

methods.name: getMergedShuffleFile
methods.description: Retrieves a merged shuffle file based on BlockId and optional directories.

methods.name: containsBlock
methods.description: Checks if a block exists on disk.

methods.name: getAllFiles
methods.description: Lists all files stored on disk.

methods.name: getAllBlocks
methods.description: Lists all block IDs stored on disk.

methods.name: createWorldReadableFile
methods.description: Creates a file with world-readable permissions.

methods.name: createTempFileWith
methods.description: Creates a temporary file with world-readable permissions.

methods.name: createTempLocalBlock
methods.description: Creates a unique temporary local block.

methods.name: createTempShuffleBlock
methods.description: Creates a unique temporary shuffle block.

methods.name: createLocalDirs
methods.description: Creates local directories for block storage.

methods.name: createLocalDirsForMergedShuffleBlocks
methods.description: Creates directories for merged shuffle blocks if push-based shuffle is enabled.

methods.name: createDirWithPermission770
methods.description: Creates a directory with 770 permissions for shuffle service.

methods.name: getMergeDirectoryAndAttemptIDJsonString
methods.description: Generates JSON string with merge directory info and attempt ID.

methods.name: addShutdownHook
methods.description: Adds a shutdown hook for cleanup.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Removes shutdown hook and initiates cleanup.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Deletes local directories if configured to do so.
